verdict.rationale: There is no statement in the evidence about training use. The pack shows only adjacent privacy controls: per-request headers can stop prompt and completion payloads from being stored in gateway logs, and DLP scanning can block sensitive information from being sent to providers. Both reduce data exposure, but neither directly addresses whether data is used to train models. Missing for 10: an explicit no-training commitment from Cloudflare, a way to enforce provider-side training opt-outs (e.g. zero-data-retention routing), and independent corroboration.
